entries.subject: Fw: GLAM- Botanic Gardens Ticket Office and Ashmolean Security- Rostering requirement
entries.body:
bump
________________________________

From: Anna Carter-Windle <anna.carter-windle@it.ox.ac.uk>
Sent: 28 May 2026 1:15 PM
To: Michael O'Sullivan <michael.osullivan@admin.ox.ac.uk>; Michelle Williams <michelle.williams@admin.ox.ac.uk>; Julie Hickman <julie.hickman@admin.ox.ac.uk>
Cc: Kevin Lelitte <kevin.lelitte@admin.ox.ac.uk>; Simon Burford <simon.burford@admin.ox.ac.uk>; Marie Cooksey <marie.cooksey@admin.ox.ac.uk>; Tracey Holland <tracey.holland@it.ox.ac.uk>; Tracy Barlow-Bacon <tracy.barlow-bacon@it.ox.ac.uk>
Subject: GLAM- Botanic Gardens Ticket Office and Ashmolean Security- Rostering requirement 
 
Hello, all,

On Tuesday, GLAM HR asked if we could meet with a manager in Botanic Gardens who was struggling with using the system. Today myself and Tracey met with Heidi, and also Harriet Webb from Botanic Gardens Ticket Office. 

During the call, it was established that the Botanic Gardens had not been very forthcoming with staffing data required to set their staff up correctly to use leave and absence in PeopleXD. We were able to identify that the Ticket Office team, have similar requirements and ways of working to the Ashmolean Security team, and would therefore benefit from Rostering implementation.

Unfortunately, we are no longer in a position to support this, and therefore, any future roll outs of Rostering, will need to be picked up by yourselves.

Please may I recommend that in the first instance, Business Change and FAs from HR Systems team meet with the GLAM HR, and establish what fact-find data you need the GLAM HR team to conduct with Ash Security and Botanic Ticket Office, to assess if 1. Rostering is the right solution, and 2. Kick start the activity to get them configured for this set up. 

I will follow up with a handover email to this team and GLAM HR as a project closure task. 

Kind regards,

Anna




Anna Carter-Windle

Business Change Manager

Contractor of AL Training Solutions Ltd

 

Workforce Management resources for HR, staff and managers <https://unioxfordnexus.sharepoint.com/sites/OXINTRANET-working-here/SitePages/workforce-management-resources-hr-staff-managers.aspx> 

 

Programme and Project Delivery Group

IT Services | University of Oxford

Dartington House, University Offices,  Oxford OX1 2JD

 

Please note my working days and hours are: 

Tuesday and Wednesday between 8am-6pm based on business needs
entries.ai_note: Kevin Lelitte bumps a forwarded request from Anna Carter-Windle (dated 28 May 2026) regarding GLAM rostering requirements for Botanic Gardens and Ashmolean; Kevin needs to address the outstanding request.

entries.subject: Strategic Health & Safety Management System project supplier requirements evaluations; upcoming deadline of Friday 21 August
entries.body:
Dear Colleague,
I hope you are managing to keep cool in the warm weather and, for those of you who have already had some time off over the summer, that you had an enjoyable and restful break.
Just a friendly reminder to please complete and return your Strategic Health & Safety Modular System supplier evaluation scoring spreadsheet by 5:00pm on Friday 21 August.
Please return your completed spreadsheet as an email attachment to: shsms@it.ox.ac.uk <mailto:shsms@it.ox.ac.uk> 
and copy:

*	helen.harbour@it.ox.ac.uk <mailto:helen.harbour@it.ox.ac.uk> 
*	sonhal.mistry@it.ox.ac.uk <mailto:sonhal.mistry@it.ox.ac.uk> 
*	caroline.gow@admin.ox.ac.uk <mailto:caroline.gow@admin.ox.ac.uk> 

Thank you again for the time and expertise you are contributing to the evaluation process. We really appreciate your support, particularly during the busy summer holiday period.
If you have any questions or encounter any issues completing your evaluation, please do get in touch with the project team.
Many thanks and kind regards,
Helen
________________________________

Cc: Strategic H and S Modular System <shsms@it.ox.ac.uk>; Caroline Gow <caroline.gow@admin.ox.ac.uk>; Rachel Midgley <rachel.midgley@it.ox.ac.uk>
Subject: Re: SH&SMS project supplier requirements evaluation template
 
Dear colleague,
I hope your evaluations are progressing well.
You may have noticed that some suppliers refer to supplementary documents within their responses which do not appear to be included in the evaluation folders. These documents can be found in the corresponding supplier folders within the following Teams location:

​​​ITT Supplementary Response Information <https://unioxfordnexus.sharepoint.com/:f:/s/ITServices-HealthandSafetyChangeProgramme/IgBwRCjv8w2gQJ-3t7u6lMDGAV93E90FtSWte8nDKGFehKk> ​​​

Apologies that these documents are in a separate location. We appreciate this is not ideal, but we will look to move them into the main supplier folders provided by Procurement during the week commencing 3 August, so that all information is available in a single location.

​​2526 - SHSMS Supplier Responses RFX0003422 <https://unioxfordnexus-my.sharepoint.com/:f:/r/personal/admn6264_ox_ac_uk/Documents/2526%20-%20SHSMS%20Supplier%20Responses%20RFX0003422?csf=1&web=1&e=SSbX6X> ​​

Thank you once again for your support with the supplier evaluations. If you have any questions at any stage, please don't hesitate to get in touch with the project team. To help ensure a prompt response, particularly as different members of the team are on leave at various times, please copy shsms@it.ox.ac.uk <mailto:shsms@it.ox.ac.uk>  into any queries.

Please don't forget to return your evaluation as an email attachment by Friday 21st August to shsms@it.ox.ac.uk copying: helen.harbour@it.ox.ac.uk, sonhal.mistry@it.ox.ac.uk, caroline.gow@admin.ox.ac.uk.

Many thanks
Helen
________________________________

From: Sonhal Mistry <sonhal.mistry@it.ox.ac.uk>
Sent: 20 July 2026 13:40
To: Nichola Selby <nichola.selby@safety.ox.ac.uk>; Brian Jenkins <brian.jenkins@safety.ox.ac.uk>; Neil Carveth <neil.carveth@socsci.ox.ac.uk>; Steve Hyde <steve.hyde@ndcls.ox.ac.uk>; Lindsey Hale <lindsey.hale@it.ox.ac.uk>; Richard McDonald <richard.mcdonald@digital.ox.ac.uk>; Martin McGovern <martin.mcgovern@it.ox.ac.uk>; Joseph Talbot <joseph.talbot@digital.ox.ac.uk>; Andrew Goff (IT Services) <andrew.goff@it.ox.ac.uk>; Nigel Brown <nigel.brown@it.ox.ac.uk>; Benjamin Hill <benjamin.hill@it.ox.ac.uk>; Ash Mohanaprakas <ash.mohanaprakas@it.ox.ac.uk>; Marie Cooksey <marie.cooksey@admin.ox.ac.uk>; Christopher Sanders <christopher.sanders@admin.ox.ac.uk>; James Salas Guillen <james.salas@admin.ox.ac.uk>; Kevin Lelitte <kevin.lelitte@admin.ox.ac.uk>
Cc: Strategic H and S Modular System <shsms@it.ox.ac.uk>; Helen Harbour <helen.harbour@it.ox.ac.uk>; Caroline Gow <caroline.gow@admin.ox.ac.uk>
Subject: SH&SMS project supplier requirements evaluation template
 

Dear colleague

 

Thank you for agreeing to evaluate suppliers responses to the tender for the Strategic Health & Safety Modular System Project.

 

As a reminder, please download and save your own copy of the attached evaluation spreadsheet before entering your scores (see attached). When completing your evaluation, please ensure that you include a justification for scores awarded. To note, we have added all the requirements to the sheet, please consistently score the requirement categories that you choose to score and do not remove any of the rows containing requirements that are not relevant to you.

 

Please refer to the guidance sheet within the workbook for the scoring criteria and further instructions.

 

Once completed, please return your evaluation as an email attachment by Friday 21st August to shsms@it.ox.ac.uk copying: helen.harbour@it.ox.ac.uk, sonhal.mistry@it.ox.ac.uk, caroline.gow@admin.ox.ac.uk.

 

You will receive access to the supplier responses from Procurement shortly. We have received six supplier submissions for evaluation (supplier names are highlighted in grey in the supplier scores sheet).

 

If you have any questions on the evaluation process or the requirements please contact: shsms@it.ox.ac.uk <mailto:shsms@it.ox.ac.uk>  copying in: helen.harbour@it.ox.ac.uk <mailto:helen.harbour@it.ox.ac.uk>  sonhal.mistry@it.ox.ac.uk <mailto:sonhal.mistry@it.ox.ac.uk> 

 

Kind Regards

 

 <https://www.it.ox.ac.uk/> 

Sonhal Mistry

Senior Business Analyst

Please note Wednesday is my non-working day

IT Services | University of Oxford
Dartington House, University Offices,

Wellington Square, Oxford OX1 2JD

 

contact me on MS Teams
